ProjectCard.note: Media block plus a title line and a shorter meta line — the real shape of a work-index card. Square corners, bg-accent, pulse.

CardGrid.note: Three cards side by side with varied line widths, so it reads as loading content rather than a repeated stamp.

TextBlock.note: Heading bar then four body lines that ragged-end like prose. Convincing as a case-study intro mid-load.

IndexRows.note: Ruled rows with a name placeholder left and a year placeholder right; matches the loaded index row for row, so nothing jumps.
